summary_en: 1,052,400 shares to be cancelled (2.83% of shares outstanding ex-treasury). Scheduled effective date 2026-09-30. Post-cancellation total issued shares: 36,135,167.
title_en: Notice Regarding Cancellation of Treasury Shares
translation_en_brief: On 28 August 2026, Saibu Gas Holdings' board of directors resolved to cancel 1,052,400 treasury shares of common stock under Article 178 of the Companies Act. The shares represent 2.83% of issued shares outstanding (ex-treasury). The cancellation is scheduled to take effect on 30 September 2026. Following the cancellation, the company's total issued shares outstanding will be 36,135,167.
